# Scenario: domain inbound + cert-issue-type none → plain HTTP (no TLS / no redirect).
# README: domain-name with none updates .certs.json mode to none; nginx listens on :80.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: domain plain HTTP none'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'setting cert mode name=e2e-http\.apinfra\.test \(absent -> none\)'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/.certs.json
grep 'e2e-http\.apinfra\.test' $HOME/.certs.json
grep '"active_mode": "none"' $HOME/.certs.json

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

# Plain HTTP on :80; no TLS / no redirect.
exec curl -sf --resolve e2e-http.apinfra.test:80:127.0.0.1 http://e2e-http.apinfra.test/
stdout 'OK'
exec curl -sI --resolve e2e-http.apinfra.test:80:127.0.0.1 http://e2e-http.apinfra.test/
! stdout '301'
! exec curl -skf --max-time 3 --resolve e2e-http.apinfra.test:443:127.0.0.1 https://e2e-http.apinfra.test/

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-http.apinfra.test
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
